title: Impact of Growing Practice of Hiring Freelancers on Wages and Retirement Adequacy
what_it_is: Impact of Growing Practice of Hiring Freelancers on Wages and Retirement Adequacy

sections.label: Freelancer share and new survey
sections.summary: Primary freelancers stayed at 8% to 10% of working residents over 10 years, so a new annual survey began in September last year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: Even though the share of these primary freelancers has remained relatively stable, at between 8% and 10% of the working residents over the last 10 years, their numbers could be growing in specific sectors, such as private hire car services, while dropping in other sectors, such as real estate.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: The emergence of "sharing economy" platforms may also enable more people to take up freelancing as a secondary source of income.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: We have, therefore, initiated a new annual survey, starting in September last year, to gather more in-depth statistics on the changes in the freelancing landscape.

sections.label: Real wage increase 2014 to 2016
sections.summary: There is a broad-based real wage increase over the three years from 2014 to 2016 across all categories.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: On the whole, there is a broad-based real wage increase over the three years from 2014 to 2016 across all categories.

sections.label: MOM worries on freelancer retirement
sections.summary: MOM has always been worried about freelancers' retirement adequacy because they contribute to MediSave but not to OA and SA.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: Over the years, MOM has always been worried about the retirement adequacy of these freelancing workers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: This is because besides contributing to their MediSave account, they do not contribute to their OA and SA.

sections.label: Freelancer home ownership survey
sections.summary: A survey is asked about, and home ownership rates show no significant difference between freelancers and full-time employees.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Has there been a survey now or is that something that the Ministry will be looking into?

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: However, if you look at, for example, home ownership, between the freelancers versus the full-time employees, there is no significant difference in the rate of ownership.

sections.label: New surveys on employment landscape
sections.summary: MOM started a new survey series; initial findings show primary freelancers did not increase significantly, with any increase mainly from secondary freelancers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: But what we are concerned about are the changes that are taking place in the employment landscape.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: And this is the reason why we thought it is timely now to start a new series of surveys to really go in-depth to understand the issues.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: Based on our initial findings from the first survey, it would appear that the number of primary freelancers did not increase significantly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: Any increase might have come mainly from the secondary freelancers.
